core_obligations: Reduce to a surjective chart (proof lines 999-1014): factor the etale morphism through the open subscheme X' which is its image; since the open immersion into X is separated and the fibre product over X' agrees with the one over X, it suffices to treat the case where the chart is surjective.

Separatedness of the fibre product (proof lines 1016-1028): in the commutative square defining the relation, the diagonal morphism j : R -> U x_S U is separated by the cited property of the diagonal; since U is a separated scheme over S the product U x_S U is separated, hence R is separated as well.

Conclude the separatedness of the chart (proof lines 1028-1034): the projection R -> U is separated because R is separated, so by the criterion for properties of representable morphisms applied to the surjective etale chart U -> X the morphism U -> X is separated.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a surjective chart by cutting out the image, separatedness being stable under the composition with an open immersion.
Prove the fibre product is a separated scheme using the separatedness of the diagonal morphism.
Apply the chart criterion to conclude separatedness of the chart.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an etale morphism from a separated scheme U to an algebraic space X is separated, and that the fibre product U x_X U is a separated scheme (statement lines 991-997). The proof (proof lines 999-1036) reduces to a surjective chart, proves the separatedness of the fibre product through the separatedness of the diagonal morphism and the separatedness of U over the base, and concludes with the chart criterion for representable morphisms. H2: a three-step argument with three inputs, written out in full.
